articles.dek: The UN General Assembly has moved Nepal's LDC graduation from 24 November 2026 to 24 November 2029. The tariff hit is smaller than feared — India takes over 80% of exports duty-free anyway — but manufacturing is about 5% of GDP, production costs run about 30% above India's, and a 167-action transition strategy is still largely on paper. Three more years is not a reprieve; it is the last deadline Nepal can afford to waste.
